proposed_spec.status_rule: A clean process exit is necessary but never sufficient. A lane is PASS_MECHANICS_C2 only when all registered clean properties pass, every mutation mapped to the lane is executed and killed, the exact lineage record validates, and required artifacts are fresh. Aggregation is conjunctive by lane and never promotes scientific_status beyond OPEN.
proposed_spec.immutability_rule: Freeze config_hash over the reviewed spec, exact mutation/property registries, fixture hashes, lineage manifests, seed ledger, tolerances, and runtime shape limits before the first scored run. Post-result registry changes require a new config ID and cannot replace the original surviving-mutation report.
proposed_spec.owner_rule: COMMON owns the generic oracle/mutation contracts and PR-123 report. Canonical lane owners remain owners of later production remediation; PR-123 may expose a defect but may not patch, close, RESCUE, or scientifically adjudicate it.

oracle_lineage_contract.personnel_rule: Track design_author_ids separately from the main-writer transcriber. A disjoint independent design author is required for the C2 independence label; otherwise the lane is author-correlated and blocked at C2 even if regression tests pass.
oracle_lineage_contract.shared_inputs_rule: Paired common inputs may be used deliberately for variance reduction only when coupling=shared_input_by_design is recorded. Paired random inputs are not evidence of independent stochastic draws.

random_contract.derivation: SeedSequence(root_seed).spawn by stable sorted lane_id, then property_id, then replicate index; never Python hash() and never global RNG
random_contract.rerun_rule: same config and environment must reproduce canonical numeric summaries and exact outcome classifications; all tolerances are preregistered

tiers.shape_limits: at most 16 frozen streams per randomized lane; arrays <= 32^3 except K6; no empirical files; no network; one process

tiers.purpose: explicit pre-merge coverage/profile receipt, not default collection
tiers.shape_limits: at most 64 frozen streams per randomized lane; K6 grids unchanged; no empirical files or network

performance_design: vectorize replicate math in NumPy and reuse immutable analytic fixture arrays within one build
do not reread YAML/policies or rehash unchanged fixtures per replicate
do not invoke the PR-117 empirical DESI job in contract tests; its sealed receipt used about 17.23 s wall and 3.10 GB RSS
do not use GPU: these bounded arrays are launch/transfer dominated and GPU availability would break hermetic replay
do not enable pytest-xdist until artifact-writing tests are isolated; lane-level pure computations may be process-parallel only in an optional profiled mode with deterministic merge order
wall-clock excess is an execution blocker, not a scientific falsifier; structural shape limits are the portable hard resource contract
deterministic_harness.coverage_rule: Each randomized property declares estimand, nominal level, simultaneous adjustment, number of frozen streams, acceptance interval, and minimum detectable mutation effect before execution. Failure blocks that lane; no post-hoc seed addition or tolerance widening is allowed.
deterministic_harness.artifact_write_rule: Compute into a temporary directory, validate every lane and metadata record, fsync, then atomically replace outputs in deterministic path order. --check never writes and exits nonzero on missing/stale/invalid artifacts.

analytic_fields: periodic_potential: v=grad[sin(x)sin(y)sin(z)], exact curl=0 and analytic Laplacian
mixed_Helmholtz: independently specified gradient plus curl components with analytic divergence/curl
manufactured_boundary_polynomial: nonperiodic exact derivatives with a preregistered boundary collar
k6_contract.order_acceptance: Use L2 errors on an explicit common interior support. For the two finest refinements, observed order must be >=1.8 for the second-order operator and >=3.5 for the fourth-order operator; zero-exact quantities use absolute error normalized by the analytic derivative scale.
k6_contract.decomposition_identity: For v=a(x)u(x), verify curl(v)=grad(a) cross u + a curl(u), then separately report coarse-grid interpolation error and boundary-collar contribution. The numerical sum must close to the full residual under a preregistered norm tolerance.
k6_contract.sqrt2_lock: Use S=sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(z), v=(S,S,S) on the periodic cube. The exact domain RMS ratio ||curl v||/||div v|| is sqrt(2); this is a synthetic isotropic-component mechanics lock, not empirical field content.
k6_contract.upper_bound_rule: Finite-grid potential-flow curl is reported only as stencil/grid/boundary-dependent numerical upper_bound. No field measurement, physical vorticity, or CF4 row/selection input may consume it.
